purpose: Diagnostic-only build to distinguish native tap/event delivery, deferred handler registration, and select-boot state/load failures.

assets/deathforth/events.df: print before invoking main-event-do-select deferred callback
assets/deathforth/game-select.df: print tutorial-done branch and tutorial region load return

interpretation.no_boot_complete: boot compile/runtime error before full core load; use the last visible boot marker to narrow file
interpretation.boot_complete_but_no_dispatch: native tap/button callback or native event queue is not delivering MAIN_EVENT_DO_SELECT
interpretation.dispatch_without_select_boot: deferred main-event-do-select registration remains no-op or registration did not occur
interpretation.select_boot_without_gstats_return: state/save load path hangs or aborts
interpretation.tutorial_false_without_load_return: tutorial region/load/mission transition path hangs or aborts
interpretation.tutorial_true: select-cyoa should appear; otherwise CYOA screen/state renderer is suspect

caveats: Diagnostic APK only; not release candidate.
Console is forced visible and may obscure gameplay.
Same local test certificate as the prior parsefix candidate; it is not the publisher certificate.
No Android device runtime test has been performed by the build environment.
